items.title: Horizontal Brick Dash DXF Pattern for Minimalist Screens
items.description: Horizontal rows of rectangles and short bars stagger across the panel in a barcode-like, brick-laid rhythm. The sharp, orderly repetition suits industrial-style fences and simple architectural dividers.

items.title: Free Greek Key Tree Medallion DXF Panel for CNC Screens
items.description: A dense Greek key border encloses a circular medallion built from a stylized branching tree with small leaf clusters and scattered dot accents. The nature motif set inside such a formal geometric frame gives this piece a distinctive blend of organic and structured styles.
